name: Dr Ingrid Bretherton
title: Dr / Endocrinologist (MBBS PhD FRACP)
description: Dr Ingrid Bretherton is an endocrinologist and the Principal and Founder of Inner North Endocrinology, with a special interest in transgender health and bone health; she completed a PhD investigating the effects of hormone therapy on bone health, body composition, and quality of life in gender diverse Australians. INE offers consultations to gender diverse adults wanting to discuss gender affirming hormone therapy (initiation and continuation); in some instances the 'informed consent model' may be suitable, in others a WPATH assessment. Private billing; not seeing under-18s at this stage.
specialties: transgender health, gender-affirming hormone therapy, bone health, endocrinology

name: Dr Laura Donaldson
title: Dr / Endocrinologist (MBBS (Hons) FRACP)
description: Dr Laura Donaldson is an endocrinologist committed to providing patient-centred, individualised care, particularly passionate about supporting people with diabetes, thyroid disorders, obesity, pituitary conditions, and providing gender-affirming care. INE offers consultations to gender diverse adults wanting to discuss initiation or continuation of gender affirming hormone therapy. Private billing; adults 18+.
specialties: gender-affirming care, gender-affirming hormone therapy, diabetes, thyroid, pituitary

name: Dr Amanda Cox
title: Dr / Endocrinologist (BBiomed MBBS MMed FRACP)
description: Dr Amanda Cox is an endocrinologist with a particular focus on diabetes, obstetric endocrinology, thyroid disorders, menopause, and gender-affirming care, whilst also welcoming all adult general endocrinology referrals. INE offers consultations to gender diverse adults wanting to discuss initiation or continuation of gender affirming hormone therapy. Private billing; adults 18+.
specialties: gender-affirming care, gender-affirming hormone therapy, diabetes, obstetric endocrinology, thyroid

name: Your Community Health - Trans and Gender Diverse Services
title: Community health trans and gender diverse program
practice: Your Community Health (wulempuri barring - East Reservoir)
description: Our program is a Victorian Government funded initiative that aims to increase health services across Victoria for trans, gender diverse and non-binary people aged 18 and over. At Your Community Health, the services we offer as part of this program include specialist GP services and peer navigation; the team also administers hormone injections. January 2026 update: our GP service and our waitlist is now closed to new clients seeking gender affirming care.
specialties: trans and gender diverse GP services, gender affirming care, hormone injections, peer navigation
